scope: Unchanged frozen week, elapsed-plan product fix, and retained-memory-only recall.

validation.fresh_checkout_ui: Desktop/mobile: 72 messages, 13 scenes, all 12 contracts, actual outcomes and strict tool grant visible; latest run selected by default without private stores.

comparison.prior_condition: provider-only-v1; source readers permitted but penalized
comparison.interpretation: Different tool condition and a single fresh extraction; not a causal accuracy ranking.

findings: The old code:past sweep inferred happened from elapsed confirmed/tentative plans. Product fix retains agreed status and marks attendance unknown, including encounter projections; nightly repair reverses only attributable clock-only history.

Native Tuesday processing ingests the unnamed group cancellation and reschedules Ben using contacts-linked distinct accounts. It declines only the pond outing; separate call and coffee remain confirmed.
Pond history is answerable through a normal event open with attached cited messages. Prior archive fallback was unnecessary for this answer.

Leo is retained as a pizza participant, but the shift-cover explanation is absent from extracted notes/wiki and from the event evidence returned to Hermes. The answer misses both expected claims, although participation itself remains in native memory.
Leo receives no recovery because zero expected facts were recalled and Hermes explicitly says the information is unavailable.
Initial pizza details include Ben’s true Saturday dinner as an extra. Expected pizza details are correct; extra grounded information is not graded as an assistant-policy failure.
realism_limitations: Native event/page payloads may include attached source citations. Dedicated archive, source opening, activity and conversation tools are disabled; this is not a facts-only storage test.
Low-noise, small synthetic corpus; actual Apple Messages/native contacts and TLS IMAP reader paths, but not a full consumer mailbox server.
Token costs are observable request/turn windows; exact causal cost of one tool call is not inferred from aggregates.
